verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 has its own documented ways to get file data out: reading persistent files without resuming compute and copying files over standard SSH/`scp`. Historical logs and the audit ledger are also readable via API. However, nothing documents a dedicated bulk export or an open-format export of snapshots, templates, or account data for leaving the platform. missing for 10: documented account-wide data export, export of snapshots/RootFS images in an open format, export format/portability documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of a full exit path.
